title: Work-Tape Rule Congruence
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with state set $S$ and $k$ work tapes, let $q\in\mathrm{Option}(S)$, let $\rho$ consist of an optional Boolean input symbol and the symbols read on the work tapes, choose a work-tape index $h<k$, and let $d\in\mathbb{Z}$. If $f,g:\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ satisfy $f(e)=g(e)$ for every integer $e$ whose absolute value is at most $|d|+1$, then the work-tape update rule at offset $d$ has the same value when computed using $f$ as when computed using $g$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite Boolean Turing machine M
Functions f and g from integers to optional Boolean symbols
